cues.en: If you've got a dishwasher that you think kinda sucks, there's a good chance that with just a few tweaks to how you use it, you can get truly clean dishes with very little effort.
cues.zh: 如果你觉得自家洗碗机有点烂，很可能只要稍微调整一下使用方式，就能轻松把碗洗得干干净净。

cues.en: Hi.
cues.zh: 嗨。

cues.en: I'm apparently the Internet's weird appliance guy, and a few years ago I made two videos on dishwashers and more specifically dishwasher detergent.
cues.zh: 我大概就是网上那个古怪的家电家伙，几年前我做了两个关于洗碗机的视频，更准确地说，是关于洗碗机洗涤剂的。

cues.en: Together, they're the length of a feature film.
cues.zh: 两个视频加起来有一部长片电影那么长。

cues.en: And you don't have time for that, so I've created this new version, which begins
cues.zh: 你肯定没时间看，所以我做了这个新版本，它从

cues.en: now. First, I want you to know that you can absolutely load a dishwasher with filthy stuff just covered in crap.
cues.zh: 现在开始。首先，我想让你知道，你完全可以把沾满污垢的脏东西装进洗碗机。

cues.en: I do it all the time.
cues.zh: 我一直这么干。

cues.en: The only prep you should need to do when loading a dishwasher is scrape off large pieces of uneaten food. The machine can handle a lot on its own, even burnt on stuff.
cues.zh: 装洗碗机时唯一需要做的准备，就是把大块剩饭菜刮掉。机器自己能处理很多，哪怕是烧焦粘住的东西。

cues.en: But it's important to understand that dishwashers are actually very simple machines doing a very simple thing.
cues.zh: 但重要的是要明白，洗碗机其实是非常简单的机器，做的是非常简单的事。

cues.en: If you ever looked in there at the spray arms and thought, that looks an awful lot like one of those twirly lawn sprinklers,
cues.zh: 如果你曾往里面看喷淋臂，心想，这看起来特别像那种旋转的草坪喷头，

cues.en: you were having a correct thought. This machine could sincerely be described as a couple of those sprinklers inside a waterproof box.
cues.zh: 那你的想法完全正确。这机器确实可以形容为防水箱里装了几个那种喷头。

cues.en: The box has racks which allow you to conveniently position stuff you want to clean like plates and bowls and flatware above those sprinklers
cues.zh: 这个箱子有碗架，让你方便地把要洗的东西，比如盘子、碗和餐具，放在喷淋臂上方，

cues.en: so that they spray all that stuff with lots and lots of water to get it squeaky clean.
cues.zh: 这样它们就会用大量水喷洗这些东西，把它们洗得干干净净。

cues.en: But dishwashers don't use lots and lots of water. In fact, they use very little because the water inside is recirculated.
cues.zh: 但洗碗机其实并不消耗大量的水。事实上，它们用水极少，因为里面的水是在循环使用的。

cues.en: The bottom of your dishwasher is actually a false bottom.
cues.zh: 你的洗碗机底部其实是一个假底。

cues.en: Below the mesh surface is a sump which holds somewhere on the order of a gallon of water.
cues.zh: 在滤网表面下方是一个集水坑，里面大约存有一加仑的水。

cues.en: That's 3.8 liters, though I'm not being that precise because the amount varies from machine to machine.
cues.zh: 也就是 3.8 升，不过我没那么精确，因为不同机器的水量会有所不同。

cues.en: When the cleaning cycle begins, an inlet valve opens to allow clean water to fill the sump, usually through a hole in the sidewall.
cues.zh: 清洗循环开始时，进水阀打开，让清水注入集水坑，通常是通过侧壁上的一个小孔。

cues.en: Once full, that valve closes and a powerful pump driven by an electric motor starts running.
cues.zh: 注满后，阀门关闭，由电动机驱动的强力泵开始运转。

cues.en: That pump forces the water through the spray arms and
cues.zh: 该水泵将水压入喷淋臂，

cues.en: that's it.
cues.zh: 就是这样。

cues.en: That spraying action is what cleans your dishes. It just has to go on for a while to be effective, hence the recirculation of water.
cues.zh: 这种喷淋动作就是清洗餐具的方式。它只需持续一段时间就能发挥作用，因此水是循环使用的。

cues.en: In some machines, the water is screened through a washable mesh filter before it reaches the pump.
cues.zh: 在某些机器中，水在到达水泵之前会通过一个可水洗的网状滤网进行过滤。

cues.en: Which brings me to tip number one.
cues.zh: 这就引出了我的第一条建议。

cues.en: Check your dishwasher's bottom for a removable filter and clean it.
cues.zh: 检查你的洗碗机底部是否有可拆卸的滤网并将其清洗干净。

cues.en: If you've never done this and you have a filter,
cues.zh: 如果你从来没清理过而且你家洗碗机有滤网的话，

cues.en: I'm very sorry for what you are about to find. It will be unpleasant.
cues.zh: 我为接下来你要发现的东西感到抱歉。那会很不美观。

cues.en: You should be cleaning that filter regularly.
cues.zh: 你应该定期清洗这个滤网。

cues.en: In other machines, the pump doubles as a macerator.
cues.zh: 在其他机器中，水泵同时兼具粉碎器的功能。

cues.en: Small blades at its intake break down bits of food like a mini garbage disposal.
cues.zh: 它进水口处的小叶片会像迷你的食物垃圾处理器一样把食物残渣打碎。

cues.en: Those machines usually don't have a filter, just a grid to catch stuff that's too big for the macerator to chew up. And, for the record,
cues.zh: 这些机器通常没有滤网，只有一个用来拦截粉碎器咬不动的大块杂物的栅格。而且，郑重声明，

cues.en: those are the only kind of dishwasher that I will ever purchase because cleaning those filters is gross.
cues.zh: 这类洗碗机是我唯一会购买的类型，因为清理那些滤网太恶心了。

cues.en: Now you might very well have realized that if it's the same water being recirculated,
cues.zh: 现在你很可能已经意识到，既然是同一盆水在循环使用，

cues.en: then as the dishwasher runs, the water inside of it is going to get yucky from all the food residue it's knocking off the plates and whatnot.
cues.zh: 那么随着洗碗机的运行，里面的水就会因为冲掉盘子上的各种食物残渣之类的东西而变得很脏。

cues.en: And yep,
cues.zh: 没错，

cues.en: that water gets real nasty real quick.
cues.zh: 这水很快就会变得非常恶心。

cues.en: So the machine periodically stops the main pump and starts up a second pump which pushes the dirty water out of the machine through a drain hose, and it may also add some clean water at the same time to help purge that drain hose and the sump of all the nasty water.
cues.zh: 所以机器会定期停掉主泵，启动第二个泵，把脏水通过排水管排出去，同时它可能还会加入一些清水，来帮助把排水管和集水坑里的脏水彻底冲干净。

cues.en: Once empty, the dishwasher fills itself up again with another gallon ish of clean water and the main pump starts back up to continue cleaning.
cues.zh: 排空后，洗碗机会再次注入大约一加仑左右的清水，主泵重新启动继续清洗。

cues.en: This fill, pump for a while, then drain sequence is going to repeat a few times, and by the end of the fourth or fifth fill and dump, all the food residue will have been removed from the items inside the dishwasher and the water in the sump is clean.
cues.zh: 这种“注水、循环冲洗、排水”的流程会重复好几次，到了第四次或第五次注水和倾倒结束时，洗碗机里物品上的所有食物残渣就都已经被清除了，集水坑里的水也是干净的。

cues.en: On the last fill, the stuff inside is simply getting rinsed, and after one last draining, the cycle will end and your dishes are clean,
cues.zh: 在最后一次注水时，里面的东西只是在被漂洗，经过最后一次排水后，整个洗盘周期就结束了，你的盘子也就洗干净了，

cues.en: all while using only a few gallons of water, in this case 4.2
cues.zh: 而这一切只用了几加仑的水，在这个例子里是 4.2

cues.en: gallons or 16 liters.
cues.zh: 加仑，也就是 16 升。

cues.en: I've described the basics of what the machine does to clean your dishes but I've skipped two important helpers,
cues.zh: 我刚才介绍了机器清洗餐具的基本原理，但我漏掉了两个重要的帮手，

cues.en: heat and chemicals.
cues.zh: 那就是热量和化学洗涤剂。

cues.en: Let's start with heat.
cues.zh: 我们先从热量说起。

cues.en: If you've ever hand washed a dirty kitchen or food thing then you've probably discovered that the process is a lot easier if the water you're using is hot.
cues.zh: 如果你曾经手洗过沾满油污的厨房用具或餐具，你大概会发现，如果用热水的话，清洗过程会轻松得多。

cues.en: This is especially true if what you're trying to clean is at all greasy.
cues.zh: 如果你想清理的东西沾了油污，这个方法尤其有效。

cues.en: The hotter the water, the more that grease softens and the more easily it will come off whatever it's stuck to.
cues.zh: 水温越高，油污软化得越多，也就越容易从附着物上脱落。

cues.en: So a dishwasher has a heating element to heat the water inside.
cues.zh: 所以洗碗机里有加热元件来加热内部的水。

cues.en: In many North American dishwashers, that heating element is exposed at the bottom and used for a heated dry option. But top tip,
cues.zh: 在很多北美洗碗机中，加热元件裸露在底部，用于加热烘干选项。但有个小建议，

cues.en: you might try turning that off.
cues.zh: 你可以试试把它关掉。

cues.en: I never use the heated dry because it feels like a waste of energy, it can damage items especially on the bottom rack, and the final rinse is quite hot anyway. So if you empty the dishwasher right after it finishes,
cues.zh: 我从不用加热烘干，因为觉得浪费能源，还可能损坏餐具，尤其是下层篮架上的，而且最后一次漂洗的水本来就够热了。所以如果洗碗机结束后马上取出餐具，

cues.en: that water will evaporate quickly unless you live in a swamp.
cues.zh: 那些水会很快蒸发，除非你住在沼泽里。

cues.en: Even if I don't get to it until the next morning though, most stuff inside is dry and I just use a dish towel for what few things might still have a bit of water on them.
cues.zh: 即使我拖到第二天早上才去取，里面大部分东西也干了，少数还有水珠的用擦碗布擦一下就行。

cues.en: But that's just, like, my opinion.
cues.zh: 不过这只是我的个人看法。

cues.en: What isn't my opinion though is that it takes a while to heat up a gallon of water with the power output of that heating element.
cues.zh: 但不是我主观看法的是，用那个加热元件的功率来加热一加仑水需要花不少时间。

cues.en: My dishwasher at home has an 800 watt element, and because energy is energy and water is water, we know that it can only elevate the temperature of the water inside by about three degrees Celsius per minute, and that's assuming absolutely no heat losses.
cues.zh: 我家的洗碗机加热元件是800瓦，因为能量就是能量、水就是水，我们知道它每分钟只能让内部水温升高约3摄氏度，而且这还是假设完全没有热损失的情况下。

cues.en: That's a pretty leisurely temperature rise, so in North America dishwashers
cues.zh: 这个升温速度相当悠闲，所以在北美，洗碗机

cues.en: are hooked up to the hot water supply at the sink.
cues.zh: 是接在水槽的热水供应上的。

cues.en: That way the water they fill with is already hot and the heating element only has to raise the temperature a little bit, though it may raise it a lot in the final rinse if you have a sanitize option.
cues.zh: 这样它们注入的水已经自带热度，加热元件只需要稍微提升一下温度即可，不过如果你开启了高温消毒选项，在最后漂洗时它可能会把温度升得很高。

cues.en: Except,
cues.zh: 然而，

cues.en: well, you know what your kitchen sink is like. Unless you've got a booster heater under there or a hot water recirculation pump,
cues.zh: 呃，你知道你家厨房水槽是什么情况。除非你在下面装了辅助加热器或者热水循环泵，

cues.en: it takes a while for the water to actually get hot when you open the tap. The cold water in the pipes between your water heater and the sink needs to be purged,
cues.zh: 否则你打开水龙头时，水要过一会儿才会真正变热。你需要先把热水器到水槽之间管道里的冷水排掉，

cues.en: and because dishwashers fill with so little water,
cues.zh: 而且因为洗碗机进水量很少，

cues.en: if it takes more than just a few seconds to get hot water at your kitchen sink, your dishwasher will begin washing with lukewarm water at best and stone cold water at worst.
cues.zh: 如果在你家厨房水槽放热水需要花上好几秒钟以上，那你的洗碗机开始洗涤时，水温往好了说是温的，往坏了说就是冰凉的。

cues.en: And that's bad, especially because the dishes are at their very dirtiest and could really use the help of heat.
cues.zh: 这可不好，特别是此时盘子正是一天中最脏的时候，非常需要热量来帮忙。

cues.en: Think about how much harder it is to get butter or cheese out of a pan when the water is cold and thus isn't softening it. So here's tip number two.
cues.zh: 想想看，当水很冷无法软化油脂时，要把平底锅里的黄油或奶酪洗掉有多难。所以这是第二个小贴士。

cues.en: Right before you start the dishwasher, run the hot water in your kitchen sink until it's properly hot.
cues.zh: 就在你启动洗碗机之前，先打开厨房水槽的热水，直到水流变得滚烫。

cues.en: That way, you ensure the dishwasher will actually fill with hot water.
cues.zh: 这样一来，就能确保洗碗机注入的确实是热水。

cues.en: Many dishwashers, like the one you're looking at now, don't even bother turning their heating element on at all during the first fill of water. So that water will only be as hot as it was when it entered.
cues.zh: 很多洗碗机，就像你现在看到的这台，在第一次注水时甚至根本不会开启加热元件。所以那盆水当时有多热，注入时就只有多热。

cues.en: Running the tap until it's actually hot may be the most important tip in this video depending on your dishwasher's programming.
cues.zh: 根据你洗碗机的程序设计，把水龙头开着放到水真的变热，可能是本视频中最重要的建议。

cues.en: Again, though, this advice is for North Americans specifically.
cues.zh: 不过，这个建议是专门针对北美用户的。

cues.en: Many other parts of the world hook the dishwasher up to cold water and the cycle programming is adjusted accordingly.
cues.zh: 世界上很多其他地方，洗碗机接的是冷水，相应的程序循环也做了调整。

cues.en: But here, they are designed to fill with and thus expect
cues.zh: 但在这里，它们是设计用来注入并因此预期

cues.en: hot water.
cues.zh: 热水的。

cues.en: If you have a delay start option,
cues.zh: 如果你有延迟启动功能，

cues.en: that might change up the programming to account for this but
cues.zh: 这可能会改变程序设计来适应这一点，但

cues.en: it also might not. So again, if you're not happy with your dishwasher,
cues.zh: 也可能不会。所以再说一次，如果你对洗碗机不满意，

cues.en: try running the tap until it's steamy hot and then start it. That alone can make a huge difference.
cues.zh: 试试把水龙头开到冒出热气，然后再启动。仅此一点就能带来巨大差别。

cues.en: And by the way, if you try this and it doesn't seem to be helping,
cues.zh: 顺便说一句，如果你试了这个办法但似乎没帮助，

cues.en: you might want to double check that your dishwasher is actually hooked into the hot water line.
cues.zh: 你也许该再确认一下你的洗碗机是不是真的接在了热水管上。

cues.en: You should see a water line under your sink with a flexible hose heading towards the dishwasher.
cues.zh: 你应该能看到水槽下面有一根水管，带一根软管通向洗碗机。

cues.en: If that hose is hooked up to the cold water supply by mistake,
cues.zh: 如果那根软管被误接到了冷水供应上，

cues.en: the machine's performance will suffer tremendously.
cues.zh: 机器的性能会大打折扣。

cues.en: But you don't just wash dishes with hot water. You're gonna need some soap, and that's why you have to buy detergent for your dishwasher.
cues.zh: 但你不会只用热水洗碗。你还需要洗涤剂，这就是为什么你得买洗碗机专用的洗涤剂。

cues.en: These chemical
cues.zh: 这些化学

cues.en: contain a non sudsing cocktail of dispersants,
cues.zh: 含有无泡沫的混合成分，包括分散剂、

cues.en: surfactants,
cues.zh: 表面活性剂、

cues.en: emulsifiers,
cues.zh: 乳化剂、

cues.en: and enzymes.
cues.zh: 和酶。

cues.en: The enzymes help to break down proteins and starches in food, and by the way, those enzymes work best when the wash water is up to temperature.
cues.zh: 酶有助于分解食物中的蛋白质和淀粉，顺便说一句，这些酶在洗涤水温达到要求时效果最好。

cues.en: So if you don't run the tap until it's hot, you can shorten the time in the wash cycle that the enzymes are effective which hurts washing performance.
cues.zh: 所以，如果你不把水龙头开到热水出来为止，就会缩短洗涤周期中酶发挥作用的时间，从而影响洗涤效果。

cues.en: It may seem like I'm hammering that point kinda hard but I am because it's important and I really want you to try running the tap until it's hot when you start the dishwasher.
cues.zh: 我好像一直在强调这一点，但这确实很重要，我真心希望你在启动洗碗机时先把水龙头开到出热水。

cues.en: Anyway, the other components in the detergent are also important.
cues.zh: 不管怎样，洗涤剂中的其他成分也很重要。

cues.en: Surfactants lower the surface tension of the water which helps it to clean. Emulsifiers
cues.zh: 表面活性剂会降低水的表面张力，从而帮助清洁。乳化剂

cues.en: encapsulate fats and oils which allows them to mix with the wash water.
cues.zh: 包裹脂肪和油脂，使它们能与洗涤水混合。

cues.en: And the dispersants keep all that washed off gunk suspended in the water so that it doesn't create residue deposits inside the dishwasher or indeed end up back on the stuff it's trying to clean.
cues.zh: 而分散剂则让所有被洗掉的污垢悬浮在水中，这样它就不会在洗碗机内部留下残留沉积物，也不会重新附着到正在清洗的物品上。

cues.en: There are usually a few other helper components depending on the detergent product, and in a moment I'll tell you the kind of dishwasher detergent I use and recommend.
cues.zh: 根据洗涤剂产品的不同，通常还会有一些其他辅助成分。稍后我会告诉你我使用并推荐的洗碗机洗涤剂。

cues.en: Spoiler alert,
cues.zh: 剧透一下，

cues.en: it's the cheapest kind.
cues.zh: 就是最便宜的那种。

cues.en: But first, I need to draw your attention to the machine's detergent dispenser.
cues.zh: 但首先，我需要提醒你注意机器的洗涤剂投放盒。

cues.en: This little dispenser is critically important to the proper operation of your dishwasher.
cues.zh: 这个小投放盒对洗碗机的正常运行至关重要。

cues.en: If you don't put your detergent in here and close that door, you may very well be wrecking your machine's cleaning performance and I cannot stress that enough.
cues.zh: 如果你不把洗涤剂放在这里并关上那个门，你很可能会严重破坏机器的清洁性能，这一点我怎么强调都不为过。

cues.en: The reason this is here is because every time the machine gets rid of the dirty water inside of it, it also gets rid of any detergent that was in the water.
cues.zh: 设置这个投放盒的原因是，机器每次排掉里面的脏水时，也会排掉水中原本含有的洗涤剂。

cues.en: And we need that detergent to clean the dishes, but we don't want it right away.
cues.zh: 我们需要洗涤剂来清洗餐具，但不能让它立刻释放。

cues.en: Think about what happens when you load it up with dirty dishes, say a bunch of plates after a big pasta dinner.
cues.zh: 想想装满脏餐具时会发生什么，比如一顿丰盛意面晚餐后的一堆盘子。

cues.en: Those plates are filthy and covered in red sauce.
cues.zh: 那些盘子很脏，沾满了红色酱汁。

cues.en: Or maybe Alfredo... Doesn't matter. Take your pick. When the machine starts spraying them with water,
cues.zh: 也可能是阿尔弗雷多酱……无所谓，随便哪种都行。当机器开始向它们喷水时，

cues.en: a bunch of that sauce is going to dissolve quickly,
cues.zh: 很多酱汁会迅速溶解，

cues.en: fall off, and end up in the wash water.
cues.zh: 脱落下来，混进洗涤水里。

cues.en: That first fill of water is known as the pre wash and since it gets dirty so quickly, the machine doesn't spend a lot of time with it. My dishwasher only spends ten minutes in the prewash before it drains that water out and fills again for the next part of the cycle known as the main wash.
cues.zh: 第一次注水称为预洗，因为水很快就变脏，机器不会在这上面花太多时间。我的洗碗机预洗只花十分钟，然后就把水排掉，再次注水，进入循环的下一阶段——主洗。

cues.en: If that dispenser wasn't there and holding the detergent back, then my dishwasher would only have ten minutes with soap in the water and then it would all be gone.
cues.zh: 如果没有那个分配器挡住洗涤剂，我的洗碗机水里只有十分钟有洗涤剂，然后就用光了。

cues.en: So only after it has drained the nasty pre wash water out and replaced it with clean water for the main wash does the dispenser door open and allow the detergent into the water.
cues.zh: 所以，只有在排掉脏的预洗水、换上干净水进入主洗之后，分配器门才会打开，让洗涤剂进入水中。

cues.en: The dishwasher will then spend a long time with that fill of water, sometimes more than an hour. So actually having detergent added at the correct time is crucial to a good cleaning performance.
cues.zh: 然后洗碗机会用这箱水洗很长时间，有时超过一小时。所以，在正确的时间加入洗涤剂，对良好的清洁效果至关重要。

cues.en: Although, I just discovered that my fancy dishwasher is able to tell how dirty the prewash water is and may switch up its program.
cues.zh: 不过，我刚发现我那台高级洗碗机能判断预洗水有多脏，并可能调整它的程序。

cues.en: That is not at all a universal thing and depends on having fancy sensors. Most machines just run predefined programs. So I'm not getting into this here but if you're curious what I'm talking about, that second channel video will explain.
cues.zh: 这根本不是普遍现象，取决于有没有高级传感器。大多数机器只是运行预设程序。所以这里我不深入讲了，但如果你好奇我在说什么，第二个频道的视频会解释。

cues.en: So tip number three, be sure to use the detergent dispenser and close it. Most of you probably already are,
cues.zh: 所以第三点技巧，一定要用洗涤剂投放器并把它关上。你们大多数人可能已经在这么做了，

cues.en: but I know there are some folks out there who skip it and just throw the detergent in the tub.
cues.zh: 但我知道有些人会跳过这一步，直接把洗涤剂扔进桶里。

cues.en: If your dishwasher's detergent dispenser is broken and that's why you aren't using it, that's going to really hurt your machine's performance and ideally it should be fixed. Though, there may be workarounds depending on your machine which I'll discuss later.
cues.zh: 如果你的洗碗机洗涤剂投放器坏了，所以才不用它，那会严重影响机器性能，理想情况下应该修好。不过，根据你的机器型号可能有变通办法，我稍后会讨论。

cues.en: But you may also remember from your previous life experience that fats and oils don't mix with plain water.
cues.zh: 但你可能也从以往的生活经验中记得，油脂和清水是不相溶的。

cues.en: You need an emulsifier to make them mix,
cues.zh: 你需要乳化剂来让它们混合，

cues.en: which is in the detergent
cues.zh: 而乳化剂就在洗涤剂里，

cues.en: but the machine doesn't let the detergent into the water until the second fill.
cues.zh: 但机器要到第二次注水时才让洗涤剂进入水中。

cues.en: So you might think that the first fill is going to struggle with fats and oils.
cues.zh: 所以你可能会想，第一次注水时对付油脂会很吃力。

cues.en: And yes, it will. And that's why many, many dishwashers have detergent dispensers like this one where there are two compartments.
cues.zh: 是的，确实会。这就是为什么很多很多洗碗机的洗涤剂投放器像这个一样有两个隔间。

cues.en: One is sealed by the gasket in the dispenser door and labeled main wash,
cues.zh: 一个由投放器门上的垫圈密封，标着主洗，

cues.en: but the pre wash compartment right next to it isn't sealed at all. There are holes in the door to allow any detergent you put in there to spill right out.
cues.zh: 但紧挨着它的预洗隔间根本没有密封。门上有孔，让你放在那里的洗涤剂直接漏出来。

cues.en: You see, before grocery stores were filled with these infernal pod and pack things, dishwasher detergent came in a box like this.
cues.zh: 你看，在杂货店摆满那些讨厌的胶囊和块状洗涤剂之前，洗碗机洗涤剂都是用这样的纸盒装的。

cues.en: It was a box of powder and you were expected to open this little spout and pour that powder into the dispenser.
cues.zh: 这是一盒粉末，你需要打开这个小倒水口，把粉末倒进洗碗机的分配器里。

cues.en: And if you put some of this powder in both of those cups,
cues.zh: 如果你把这些粉末倒进两个槽里，

cues.en: then the one with holes in the lid would just spill its contents out and so the dishwasher would begin its cycle with some detergent.
cues.zh: 那么盖子上有孔的那个就会把里面的东西漏出来，这样洗碗机在开始运转时就已经带有一点洗涤剂了。

cues.en: That meant it could tackle fats and oils immediately
cues.zh: 这意味着它可以立即溶解油脂，

cues.en: so the prewash was much more effective.
cues.zh: 所以预洗的效果会好得多。

cues.en: Then when it drained out that nasty water and filled again for the main wash, it would open the dispenser and let out a second round of detergent to replace what just got pumped out.
cues.zh: 然后，当它排掉那些脏水并重新注水进行主洗时，它会打开分配器，释放第二轮洗涤剂，来补充刚才被抽排掉的部分。

cues.en: That second fill would have a head start thanks to the prewash detergent getting rid of at least some fats and oils already.
cues.zh: 由于预洗洗涤剂已经去除了至少一部分油脂，第二次注水就能获得更好的起点。

cues.en: And in case you're thinking this is some lost art, my much newer dishwasher,
cues.zh: 如果你觉得这是一种已经失传的技巧，我那台更新的洗碗机——

cues.en: a model still on sale, works the same way. The lid of the dispenser has a divot labeled pre wash and if you put a little detergent there, it cleans much better.
cues.zh: 一款目前仍在销售的型号，工作原理也是一样的。分配器的盖子上有一个标着“预洗”的凹槽，如果你在那里放一点洗涤剂，洗碗效果会好得多。

cues.en: Detergent pods and tablets, while they are a convenient concept,
cues.zh: 洗碗胶囊和药片虽然是个很方便的概念，

cues.en: break this pattern.
cues.zh: 却打破了这种模式。

cues.en: And especially if you have an older dishwasher which wasn't born in the time of predosed detergent dominance,
cues.zh: 特别是如果你用的是一台老式洗碗机，它并不是在预定量洗涤剂盛行的时代诞生的，

cues.en: those products can, frankly,
cues.zh: 坦白说，那些产品，

cues.en: suck.
cues.zh: 真的很烂。

cues.en: Now, I know many of you out there are having a fine experience using those products, and by all means you should keep using them if you're happy.
cues.zh: 好了，我知道你们很多人在使用这些产品时体验很不错，如果你用得很满意，当然应该继续使用。

cues.en: But if you're not happy with your dishwasher or you're a value obsessed midwesterner like I am, here's tip number four.
cues.zh: 但如果你对自家的洗碗机不满意，或者像我一样是个极度看重性价比的中西部人，来看第四个建议。

cues.en: Try a more basic detergent product and place some of it in both spots your machine expects it to go.
cues.zh: 试试更基础的洗涤剂，并在机器指定的两个投放槽里都放上一些。

cues.en: If your dishwasher doesn't have a dedicated spot to put prewash detergent,
cues.zh: 如果你的洗碗机没有专门放预洗洗涤剂的地方，

cues.en: just add a little extra along the door or directly into the washtub. Something like a tablespoon will be fine.
cues.zh: 只需沿着门边或直接倒进洗衣桶里再加一点就行，大约一汤匙即可。

cues.en: And if you're skeptical that this will actually do anything,
cues.zh: 如果你怀疑这真的能起什么作用，

cues.en: well your dishwasher still has that dispenser, right? It's still holding the detergent back until the second fill. Otherwise, the dispenser would be pointless.
cues.zh: 你家洗碗机还有那个分配器，对吧？它还是会把洗涤剂留到第二次注水才释放。不然的话，这个分配器就没意义了。

cues.en: So give it a try. Can't hurt.
cues.zh: 所以去试试吧。不会有什么坏处的。

cues.en: Speaking of giving things a try, there's a brand of detergent which has come out with yet another new product, this time touting cycle sync technology.
cues.zh: 说到勇于尝试，有个洗涤剂品牌又推出了一款新产品，这次他们吹捧的是周期同步技术。

cues.en: Right ingredient,
cues.zh: 原料对路，

cues.en: asterisk, right time.
cues.zh: 星号，在合适的时候。

cues.en: What does that mean?
cues.zh: 这意味着什么？

cues.en: Finish
cues.zh: 请提供需要翻译的英文字幕内容。

cues.en: Ultimate is our first ever tablet with Cycle Sync technology
cues.zh: Ultimate 是我们首款搭载 Cycle Sync 技术的平板电脑

cues.en: that releases the right ingredient, asterisk, to act at the right time.
cues.zh: 这会释放出正确的成分——星号，以便在正确的时间发挥作用。

cues.en: That sure implies that these will align their vibes with my machine or something, but is there anything to that implication?
cues.zh: 这确实暗示这些会和我的机器气场相合之类的，但这种暗示有依据吗？

cues.en: First, let's put one of these tablets in my dishwasher and let it run for a bit.
cues.zh: 首先，把其中一颗药片放进洗碗机里，让它运行一会儿。

cues.en: Yeah. It all dissolved in a matter of minutes. So if I didn't put this in the dispenser, which the instructions explicitly tell me to do,
cues.zh: 是的，几分钟内就全溶解了。所以如果我没把它放进分配器里，而说明书明确要求我这么做，

cues.en: all of it would have drained out after ten minutes. So it doesn't appear to be anything to do with these three sections of seemingly different items.
cues.zh: 十分钟后，所有的内容都会流失殆尽。所以这似乎和这三个看似不同的部分没有任何关系。

cues.en: They're just making this prettier.
cues.zh: 他们只是把这个做得更漂亮了。

cues.en: Since my dishwasher doesn't have a hole in its side, I'll pour hot water from the tap into this glass pan so we can watch how the tablets dissolve.
cues.zh: 既然我的洗碗机侧面没开洞，我就把水龙头里的热水倒进这个玻璃盘里，好看看这些片剂是怎么溶解的。

cues.en: Yeah. It's just it's just all oozing out once the membrane is breached.
cues.zh: 对。就是，就是膜一破，它就全渗出来了。

cues.en: I should note, I tried this last time with their compressed tablet things and I had the same thing happen. It completely dissolved in my dishwasher after ten minutes.
cues.zh: 我得说明一下，上次我用他们那种压缩片剂试过，也发生了同样的情况。十分钟后它就在我的洗碗机里完全溶解了。

cues.en: So what do they even mean by cycle sink?
cues.zh: 那他们说的 cycle sink 到底是什么意思？

cues.en: Let's find where that asterisk leads to. Oh, and by the way, this is actually called a double dagger and not an asterisk. Fun pedantic typography fact.
cues.zh: 我们看看那个星号指向哪里。哦，顺便说一句，这其实叫双剑号，不是星号。一个有趣的排版学究冷知识。

cues.en: It's on the bottom. Of course it is.
cues.zh: 在底部。当然了。

cues.en: Enzyme.
cues.zh: 酶。

cues.en: That's it? The word enzyme?
cues.zh: 就这？就一个“酶”字？

cues.en: The protease and amylase enzymes that are also found in this Walmart brand powder?
cues.zh: 蛋白酶和淀粉酶，这些酶在这个 Walmart 品牌粉末里也有？

cues.en: The enzymes that work best at high temperatures so will indeed get more effective at the right time?
cues.zh: 这些酶在高温下效果最好，所以到了合适的时候确实会更有效？

cues.en: I don't know if you see how sneaky it is to put that mark after the word ingredient
cues.zh: 我不知道你有没有看出，把那个标记放在 ingredient 这个词后面有多狡猾

cues.en: but hopefully you do.
cues.zh: 但希望你看出来了。

cues.en: The thing is, if it's not clear already,
cues.zh: 关键是，如果这还不明显的话，

cues.en: these are just tablets of soap dressed up to seem important.
cues.zh: 这些只是被包装得好像很重要的肥皂片而已。

cues.en: Your dishwasher is the thing doing the work and there's nothing all that special about these.
cues.zh: 真正干活的是你的洗碗机，这些东西没什么特别的。

cues.en: And not to get too tinfoil hat on you but it does feel weird to me that there's so much differentiation
cues.zh: 不是想让你觉得我太阴谋论，但我确实觉得奇怪：居然有这么多差异化

cues.en: for a commodity product like dishwasher detergent.
cues.zh: 对洗碗机洗涤剂这种普通商品来说。

cues.en: Powders and gels tend to live a sad life on the bottom shelf while the flashy pods get all the attention. But I sincerely think these are the better products because they jibe with the way dishwashers
cues.zh: 粉末和凝胶洗涤剂在底层货架上往往备受冷落，而那些花哨的洗碗块却吸引了所有的目光。但说实话，我认为前两者其实是更好的产品，因为它们更符合洗碗机的

cues.en: actually work and they're a better value to boot.
cues.zh: 实际工作原理，而且性价比更高。

cues.en: I much prefer powders because it comes in a paper box and not a plastic jug but
cues.zh: 我个人更喜欢粉末状洗涤剂，因为它们是用纸盒包装而不是塑料桶，不过

cues.en: gels are much more readily available.
cues.zh: 凝胶更容易买到。

cues.en: However, powder products can contain both bleach and enzymes which aren't stable together in a liquid so powders are usually more effective
cues.zh: 然而，粉末产品可以同时包含漂白剂和酶，这两种成分在液体中无法同时保持稳定，所以粉末通常更有效，

cues.en: if you can find them.
cues.zh: 前提是你能买得到。

cues.en: However, there's a wrinkle but it's double edged.
cues.zh: 不过，这里有个棘手的问题，而且是一把双刃剑。

cues.en: One of the reasons I like powder and gel is because how much detergent you actually need to use varies.
cues.zh: 我喜欢粉末和凝胶的原因之一，是因为你实际需要的洗涤剂用量是可变的。

cues.en: If you have soft water, you likely need to use very little and you can stretch a box like this for months.
cues.zh: 如果你使用的是软水，你可能只需要用极少的一点，这样一盒就能用上好几个月。

cues.en: But if you have hard water, you'll need to use more.
cues.zh: 但如果你用的是硬水，你就需要用量更大。

cues.en: Also, how soiled your dishes are affects things too because the detergent gets used up and becomes less effective as it tackles food deposits.
cues.zh: 此外，餐具的脏污程度也会有影响，因为洗涤剂在分解食物残留的过程中会被消耗，效果也会减弱。

cues.en: I strongly believe that the two dose structure of traditional dishwasher programs
cues.zh: 我坚信传统洗碗机程序的两次投放结构

cues.en: means you can use much less detergent.
cues.zh: 意味着你可以使用少得多的洗涤剂。

cues.en: You're not expecting the detergent to do everything with a single fill of wash water.
cues.zh: 你不会指望只靠单次注入的清洗水让洗涤剂搞定一切。

cues.en: But the tabs and packs are though, so they're extremely
cues.zh: 但洗碗块和洗碗球就是这么设计的，所以它们极其

cues.en: concentrated
cues.zh: 浓缩，

cues.en: to get all the work done at once.
cues.zh: 以便一次性完成所有清洗工作。

cues.en: The wrinkle in dosing it yourself though is that it's pretty easy to use too much detergent.
cues.zh: 不过，自己掌握用量的麻烦之处在于，很容易不小心放太多洗涤剂。

cues.en: The cups in the dispenser are big for those of you who have really hard water and need a lot of detergent,
cues.zh: 分配器里的杯子很大，是给那些水质很硬、需要很多洗涤剂的人用的，

cues.en: but most people don't. So if you're trying out a powder or gel product and find you're left with a powdery residue on your stuff,
cues.zh: 但大多数人不是这样。所以如果你试用粉状或凝胶洗涤剂，发现东西上残留粉末，

cues.en: you're using too much detergent and the final rinse couldn't get rid of it all.
cues.zh: 那就是你用得太多了，最后一次漂洗没能冲干净。

cues.en: The boxes don't explain that, they say to fill the cups completely which is almost always a terrible idea. You'd be surprised how little you actually need.
cues.zh: 包装盒上没解释这点，它们说要把杯子装满，这几乎总是一个糟糕的主意。你会惊讶于自己实际需要的量是如此之少。

cues.en: I really appreciate being able to fiddle with this and I've discovered I only need to fill the cup up about halfway pretty much no matter what I'm cleaning,
cues.zh: 我很庆幸能自己调整用量，我发现无论洗什么，基本只需要装到杯子的一半左右，

cues.en: but your brain may vary.
cues.zh: 但你的情况可能不同。

cues.en: Detergent packs force a one size fits all amount of detergent on you which very much rubs me the wrong way,
cues.zh: 洗涤剂胶囊强迫你接受一刀切的用量，这让我很不舒服，

cues.en: but it usually works and there are many people who would prefer that. Those four tips. Look for filters and clean them, run the kitchen tap until the water's hot before you start the machine,
cues.zh: 但它通常有效，而且很多人更喜欢这样。那四个技巧：找到过滤器并清洁它们，启动机器前先打开厨房水龙头放到水热，

cues.en: use the detergent dispenser and close the lid, and finally consider using a basic detergent product and add a little pre wash detergent,
cues.zh: 使用洗涤剂分配器并盖上盖子，最后考虑用基础洗涤剂产品并加一点预洗洗涤剂，

cues.en: are what I consider the most important things to try.
cues.zh: 是我认为最值得尝试的要点。

cues.en: I have used some astoundingly
cues.zh: 我用过一些便宜得惊人的

cues.en: cheap dishwashers in my time including the gnarliest landlord special I've ever encountered.
cues.zh: 洗碗机，包括我遇到过的最恶心的房东特供款。

cues.en: That thing didn't even have a sprayer for its top rack and boy was it loud.
cues.zh: 那东西上层架子甚至没有喷淋器，而且天啊，它吵得要命。

cues.en: But it cleaned everything
cues.zh: 但它把所有东西都洗得干干净净

cues.en: just fine and with Walmart brand detergent.
cues.zh: 而且用的还是沃尔玛自有品牌洗涤剂。

cues.en: The only thing I can attribute my seemingly perfect dishwasher scorecard to is actually putting detergent in both places all those machines expected it to go and always running the kitchen tap until it's hot before I started the cycle.
cues.zh: 我这看似完美的洗碗机评分卡，唯一能归功于的就是：在所有机器期望的位置都放入洗涤剂，并且在启动程序前总是把厨房水龙头开到出热水。

cues.en: Now we've blown past the twenty minute mark and this video is supposed to be more shareable than the others, so I'll finish up with a lightning round of other tips you might try.
cues.zh: 现在已经超过二十分钟了，而这期视频本该比其他视频更值得分享，所以我用一轮快问快答式的其他技巧来收尾。

cues.en: If none of what I've gone over seems to be helping, try a dishwasher cleaning product before you give up. Lime scale and other forms of buildup can clog the sprayer nozzles or make the pump less effective and many products are available which help get rid of those deposits.
cues.zh: 如果我讲的所有方法似乎都没用，那在放弃之前试试洗碗机清洁产品。水垢和其他形式的积垢会堵塞喷淋嘴或降低泵的效率，市面上有很多产品能帮助清除这些沉积物。

cues.en: I'm partial to products like this which come in a bottle.
cues.zh: 我偏爱这种瓶装的产品。

cues.en: You insert them upside down and a wax plug holds the product back until the water is hot enough to melt it.
cues.zh: 把它们倒着放进去，一个蜡塞会挡住产品，直到水温足够高把它融化。

cues.en: When I use these, I actually don't run the water hot first to make sure the plug doesn't melt during the prewash,
cues.zh: 我用这些的时候，其实不会先把水烧热，以确保蜡塞在预洗阶段不会融化，

cues.en: and I use the machine's tough setting with the high temp wash option selected.
cues.zh: 而且我会用机器的强力档并选择高温洗涤选项。

cues.en: I've used both this glisten product and Finish's version of a similar thing and find them to be great. Note, the Finish product has a heavy perfume which lingers through several washes.
cues.zh: 我用过这款 Glisten 产品以及 Finish 的类似产品，觉得它们都很棒。注意，Finish 的产品有浓重的香精味，会残留好几轮洗涤。

cues.en: I like that but it might bother others so be aware of that. You could also use a product like Lemmishine which is just powdered citric acid.
cues.zh: 我喜欢这点，但别人可能会介意，所以要有心理准备。你也可以用像 Lemmishine 这样的产品，它其实就是粉末状的柠檬酸。

cues.en: If a deep cleaning of your dishwasher still doesn't fix things, your dishwasher likely has a worn out pump impeller or something else is mechanically wrong. Or you may have the rare, actually bad dishwasher model and might just have to replace it.
cues.zh: 如果深度清洁洗碗机后还是不行，很可能是水泵叶轮磨损了，或者有其他机械故障。又或者你碰巧买到了极少见的劣质型号，那就只能换新的了。

cues.en: If your dishwasher's detergent dispenser is broken and that's why you aren't using it, first, you might try your hand at replacing it if you feel up to it. Replacement parts are often available, and this is YouTube, I'm sure there are many guides out there possibly for your specific dishwasher.
cues.zh: 如果是因为洗碗粉盒坏了你才没用它，首先，要是你觉得自己搞得定，可以尝试自己动手换一个。通常都能买到替换配件，而且这里是 YouTube，肯定能搜到针对你这款机型的教程。

cues.en: Though I won't be endorsing any of them.
cues.zh: 虽说我不会为其中任何一个教程背书。

cues.en: But even without a functional dispenser, your dishwasher may be able to work with a different cycle.
cues.zh: 但就算洗涤盒坏了，换个洗涤程序你的洗碗机说不定也能凑合用。

cues.en: Express or Ecocycles
cues.zh: 快速或节能模式

cues.en: often don't do a prewash fill and open the dispenser right away.
cues.zh: 通常没有预洗注水环节，而是一开始就会打开洗涤盒。

cues.en: Those are typically options for a faster wash with the trade off of reduced effectiveness.
cues.zh: 这些模式通常洗得更快，但代价就是洗净效果有所打折。

cues.en: I don't know what dishwasher you have but you can listen out for it draining and determine how long it spends with each fill.
cues.zh: 我不知道你用的是哪款洗碗机，但你可以听听排水声，判断每次注水后它洗了多久。

cues.en: If some cycles begin with it spending thirty or forty minutes with the same water,
cues.zh: 如果某个模式一上来就用同一管水洗上三四十分钟，

cues.en: those will be what you want.
cues.zh: 那就是你要找的模式了。

cues.en: But if your dispenser works, the normal cycle or auto cycle is probably what you want to use day to day.
cues.zh: 但如果洗涤盒没坏，平时用标准洗或自动洗模式基本就够了。

cues.en: Speaking of cycles though,
cues.zh: 不过说到洗涤模式，

cues.en: you shouldn't be afraid to try the other cycles and options available to you. The tough settings don't make the washing action stronger,
cues.zh: 你完全可以大胆尝试其他的程序和选项。强力模式并不会加大冲洗力度，

cues.en: they just make it go on longer and might get the water hotter.
cues.zh: 它只是洗得更久，水温可能也更高。

cues.en: So give it a try.
cues.zh: 所以试试看。

cues.en: If you have a high temperature wash option, that might be good to try too. Though, I will say that in my experience, using it can exacerbate hard water deposits in some situations.
cues.zh: 如果你的洗碗机有高温洗选项，也可以试试。不过我要说，根据我的经验，在某些情况下，使用它可能会加重硬水沉积。

cues.en: Same goes with the sanitize option. I really only use that if there's something in the dishwasher that I feel might need it.
cues.zh: 消毒选项也是一样。我只有在觉得洗碗机里的某些东西可能需要消毒时，才会用它。

cues.en: Next,
cues.zh: 接下来，

cues.en: rinse aids.
cues.zh: 漂洗剂。

cues.en: Use them. This isn't a scam and most dishwashers have a rinse aid dispenser right next to the detergent dispenser.
cues.zh: 用它。这不是骗人的，而且大多数洗碗机在洗涤剂分配器旁边都有漂洗剂分配器。

cues.en: It'll squirt a little bit of this stuff out in the final rinse and all that it is is a very mild surfactant which reduces the surface tension of water causing it to form a thin film which easily evaporates without leaving water spots.
cues.zh: 它会在最后一次漂洗时喷出一点这种液体，这其实是一种非常温和的表面活性剂，可以降低水的表面张力，使水形成一层薄膜，蒸发后不容易留下水渍。

cues.en: This is particularly helpful to use if you have hard water and many machines allow you to vary how much rinse aid it dispenses.
cues.zh: 如果你那里的水质较硬，使用漂洗剂尤其有帮助，而且很多洗碗机都允许你调节漂洗剂的用量。

cues.en: You'll need more the harder your water is.
cues.zh: 水越硬，需要的漂洗剂就越多。

cues.en: This stuff is so simple there's no need to go name brand. Just get the cheap stuff. And to European viewers, many of your dishwashers have built in water softeners and require dishwasher salt.
cues.zh: 这东西非常简单，没必要买大品牌，买便宜的就行。至于欧洲的观众，你们那里的很多洗碗机内置了软水器，需要使用洗碗机盐。

cues.en: So make sure you got that on hand and fill it up if you need to. If you aren't able to find powders or gels in your area or they pose a challenge for you to use for whatever reason,
cues.zh: 所以确保手头有洗碗机盐，需要时把它加满。如果你所在的地区买不到粉末或凝胶洗涤剂，或者因为某些原因用起来不方便，

cues.en: I would recommend trying the cheapest store brand dishwasher tablets or pods you can find.
cues.zh: 我建议试试你能找到的最便宜的超市自有品牌洗碗块或洗碗凝珠。

cues.en: You may very well find they work great.
cues.zh: 你很可能发现它们效果很好。

cues.en: And if they don't,
cues.zh: 如果不行，

cues.en: try mimicking what you can do with powder and gel by putting one in the dispenser and another directly into the tub.
cues.zh: 那就试试模仿粉剂和凝胶的用法：把其中一种放进分配盒，另一种直接放进洗碗机内胆。

cues.en: Pods are quite concentrated so that runs the risk of leaving a residue but it's something to try if your dishwasher isn't that great.
cues.zh: 凝珠浓度很高，因此有留下残留物的风险；但如果你的洗碗机不太好用，这仍值得一试。

cues.en: I honestly wish detergent people would make a two section pod with a removable baby pod for use in the prewash.
cues.zh: 说实话，我真希望洗涤剂厂商能做出双仓凝珠，带一个可拆下的小凝珠，专门用于预洗。

cues.en: I probably still wouldn't use that because I find powder in a box with the spout to be plenty convenient already but that feels like a useful option.
cues.zh: 不过我大概还是不会用，因为我觉得带出料口的盒装粉剂已经足够方便了，但这感觉是个有用的选择。

cues.en: Oh, and in case you might find using this box difficult,
cues.zh: 哦，如果你觉得用这个盒子不方便，

cues.en: you might try emptying it into a storage container that you can use a scoop with.
cues.zh: 可以试着把它倒进一个能用勺子舀的收纳容器里。

cues.en: That might also help if you live somewhere very damp and powder will cake up on you. But not for nothing. I never have that problem here in the Midwest and I keep this under the sink.
cues.zh: 如果你住在非常潮湿的地方，粉剂会结块，这也可能有帮助。不过说真的，我在中西部从没遇到这个问题，而且我就把它放在水槽下面。

cues.en: And lastly,
cues.zh: 最后，

cues.en: I didn't really want to go here because it's the source of strife for many a family
cues.zh: 我其实不太想提这个，因为这是许多家庭矛盾的来源，

cues.en: but make sure you're loading the dishes correctly.
cues.zh: 但一定要确保碗碟摆放正确。

cues.en: The sprayers are below the racks so the dirty surfaces should be facing down.
cues.zh: 喷水臂在碗架下方，所以脏的表面应该朝下。

cues.en: Additionally, since the sprayers rotate around the center of the machine, the dirty surfaces of vertical objects like plates should ideally face inward.
cues.zh: 另外，由于喷水臂围绕机器中心旋转，像盘子这类竖直放置的物体，其脏面最好朝内。

cues.en: When I'm loading it, the left hand side looks like this and right of the center line, it looks like that.
cues.zh: 我摆放的时候，左侧看起来是这样，中心线右侧看起来是那样。

cues.en: Also, be sure things aren't bunching together and blocking their neighbors from being hit by the sprayers. And, this is important, make sure those sprayer arms can spin freely.
cues.zh: 另外，确保餐具没有堆叠在一起，挡住相邻的餐具被喷淋臂冲洗。还有很关键的一点，务必确保喷淋臂能自由旋转。

cues.en: Tall items in the bottom rack can stop the top rack's sprayer from spinning.
cues.zh: 下层架子上太高的餐具可能会卡住上层喷淋臂，让它转不起来。

cues.en: And that's not good. A whole lot of stuff will get hardly any water if it stays in one place throughout the cycle.
cues.zh: 这可不太妙。如果喷淋臂在整个洗涤过程中都卡在一个位置，很多餐具就几乎冲不到水。

cues.en: The top rack is often adjustable and can be raised up to minimize this, so if stuff on the top rack is often dirty for you, give that a try. And be mindful that on either rack,
cues.zh: 上层架通常是可以调节的，调高一点就能改善这种情况，所以如果你上层的餐具总洗不干净，不妨试试看。另外还要注意，无论在哪一层架子上，

cues.en: there's less washing action at the corners because it's a square on top of a circle. So if you're washing something that's really dirty,
cues.zh: 角落里的冲洗力度都会弱一些，因为喷淋范围是圆形，而架子是方形的。所以如果你要洗特别脏的餐具，

cues.en: you'll want to keep it close to the center.
cues.zh: 最好尽量把它放在靠近中间的位置。

cues.en: And I think that's it.
cues.zh: 我想差不多就这些了。

cues.en: I want to reiterate that if you're not having any problems with your dishwasher,
cues.zh: 我想再次重申，如果你的洗碗机用着没有任何问题，

cues.en: you don't have to change your habits, though you're probably not watching this.
cues.zh: 你完全不需要改变使用习惯——虽说那种情况下你大概也不会看这个视频。

cues.en: But gosh, I'd really like more people to just buy plain powder because it feels like this is an endangered species.
cues.zh: 但我真的非常希望大家能多买买普通的洗碗粉，因为感觉它都快成濒危物种了。

cues.en: My local Walmart keeps just a single slot of shelf space for this stuff and they're often out.
cues.zh: 我家附近的 Walmart 货架上就只留了一小格位置放它，而且还经常断货。

cues.en: I'm to the point of checking for it every time I stop in for whatever random thing brings me to Walmart.
cues.zh: 我现在已经到了不管去 Walmart 顺便买什么，都得跑过去看一眼有没有洗碗粉的地步。

cues.en: And while I don't want to say pods don't work, clearly they do for many people, the feedback from the last videos was amazing.
cues.zh: 虽然我并不是说洗碗凝珠没用，对很多人来说显然是好用的，但上期视频大家的反馈确实非常惊人。

cues.en: Many people reported that their dishwashers were cleaning like never before and all thanks to trying
cues.zh: 很多人反映，他们的洗碗机从未洗得这么干净，而这一切都归功于尝试了

cues.en: cheap detergent and using it as their machine
cues.zh: 便宜的洗涤剂，并按机器的

cues.en: expects.
cues.zh: 预期用法来使用。

cues.en: I'm reasonably sure you'll see many comments like that below this video.
cues.zh: 我相当确定，你会在视频下方看到很多这样的评论。

cues.en: Your dishwasher is responsible for 99%
cues.zh: 你的洗碗机承担了99%

cues.en: of the work. Detergents are necessary, of course, but it's just soap.
cues.zh: 的工作量。洗涤剂当然必不可少，但它终究只是肥皂。

cues.en: And I for one think that luxury soap products which go into a machine and don't deliver any kind of unique experience but perhaps a vague hint of fragrance
cues.zh: 而我个人认为，那些放进机器里、不带来任何独特体验、或许只留一缕隐约香气的奢华肥皂产品

cues.en: are silly.
cues.zh: 很傻。

cues.en: Thanks for watching and here's to clean dishes.
cues.zh: 感谢观看，祝大家餐具洁净。
